finding: History Hub reopens a server-persisted consultation in the workspace, but the workspace silently falls back to the ephemeral 'In-Chair Patient' scratchpad — the selected patient's identity is never shown
steps: POST /api/notes/jobs via Finish-Consult equivalent creates consultation 'A B' (id 155073ca…, date 'Sep 28', time '09:47 AM', status 'In Review', patientId a2bb4ced)
History Hub shows Patient Records (1) with row 'AB A B Comprehensive Examination 09:47 AM In Review'
expected: Patient banner shows patient 'A B' (name/DOB strip per OperatoryPatientBanner), encounter 1/1 is that consultation, and its content is displayed.
actual: Banner shows 'In-Chair Patient', 'DOB: Not recorded', time = current clock (09:51 AM, later 10:06 AM) — the chair-active fallback encounter, not the selected consultation. Note canvas empty ('0 lines recorded'). No error, no toast, no indication that the requested record is not on screen.
root-cause hypothesis (evidence only, no: ChairsideWorkspace sets activePatientId from initialPatientId in an effect (line 204-211) and marks it manually selected

encountersForDate filters encounters by date match: c.date === currentDateStr ('2026-09-28' format) — but the server record's date is the format 'Sep 28' (formatClinicDate output), and the fallback formatClinicDate(d) parse path appears to fail or not match, so the consultation never enters encountersForDate

activePatientId no longer matches any encounter → self-healing branch (line 522) resets to encountersForDate[0] — but encountersForDate is EMPTY for today, so activePatientId becomes '' and effectiveEncounter falls back to the 'In-Chair Patient' scratchpad (line 579+)
Net effect: the patient whose record was clicked is silently replaced by a placeholder identity
risk: Wrong-patient class: the clinician believes they reopened patient 'A B' (History Hub row disappears from view) but the screen shows an empty scratchpad for a generic 'In-Chair Patient'. Anything typed next is attributed to the scratchpad, not to 'A B'. Related doc: docs/reviews/consultation_recording_review_2026_09_26.md E3 (ghost fallback).

dateFormatEvidence.filter: encountersForDate: d === currentDateStr || d === shortDate || d.startsWith(shortDate) || d === fullDate; shortDate='Sep 28' matched only if parse produced it — observed result: record absent from roster
